author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 내륙에서 규칙적으로 겨울을 나는 기러기 가운데 가장 작은 드문 겨울철새다. 다른 기러기 무리에 섞여 드물게 눈에 띈다. 서식지와 먹이가 줄어들어 위협을 받고 있다.

points.en: white blaze reaching far up onto the crown (adult)

points.ko: 짙은 갈색 머리와 짧고 굵은 목
points.en: uniformly dark brown head and short, thick neck

art.subject: Lesser White-fronted Goose (Anser erythropus), adult in winter: head and neck dark grey-brown; a bright white blaze around the bill base that extends up the forehead to a point on the crown; a conspicuous swollen yellow eye-ring; back and wings grey-brown with pale fringes forming neat bars; breast paler grey-brown, with a few small black patches on the belly; dark flanks topped by a white line along the folded wing; vent and undertail coverts white; small, short, bright pink bill with a whitish nail; orange legs and feet.
art.pose: standing among a flock of larger geese, side view
art.scene: inland Korean wintering ground in winter, a mixed flock of geese; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in winter, side view standing: small rounded head with a steep forehead, white blaze reaching far up onto the crown, swollen bright yellow eye-ring, short stubby pink bill, uniformly dark brown head and upper neck, short thick neck, grey-brown body with black patches on the belly, bright orange legs

first-winter, side view standing: same small rounded head and short thick neck, yellow eye-ring, short pink bill, no white blaze at the bill base, plain grey-brown belly without black patches, orange legs
art.build: Small, compact goose, clearly smaller than Greater White-fronted Goose (Anser albifrons) and bean geese, with a short neck, small rounded head and steep forehead. Bill short and stubby, much shorter than the head. Legs orange. At rest the long wingtips extend clearly beyond the tail tip. Grazes with quick pecking among flocks of larger geese.
avoid: Do not omit the yellow eye-ring; it is the key difference from Greater White-fronted Goose (Anser albifrons).
Do not paint a long bill or a white blaze stopping at the bill base; the blaze reaches up onto the crown.
Do not paint an orange or black-and-orange bill (bean goose traits); the bill is pink.
Do not paint heavy black bars covering the whole belly; the black patches are small.
